pages.title: Learn
pages.summary: Seventy-eight self-contained rooms for Control Hub, Webex Calling, both contact-center products, Dedicated Instance, migrations, SIP, flows, workforce and quality, AI agents, and platform bridges. Read offline. Product claims stay cited.

pages.title: Start here
pages.summary: Read Control Hub before a dial plan, and the contact-center overview before a queue. The 30/60/90 sequence is a Canon study plan. It is not a Cisco learning path and it does not promise an exam result.

pages.title: Quizzes
pages.summary: 483 checks across the written rooms. Room pages keep their own quizzes. Reveals on a room still update that room’s progress. This bank is practice.

pages.title: Flashcards
pages.summary: 842 flashcards from the written-room glossaries and the facts those rooms cite. Know and Again stay in localStorage on this machine. Nothing is uploaded.

pages.title: Labs
pages.summary: Five study models in this browser. They cite the sentence they imitate. They are not Unified CM, not a contact-center tenant, and not a calling-search-space trace from a live cluster.

pages.title: Interviews
pages.summary: Questions a Webex Calling, Webex Contact Center, or UCCE-to-WxCC conversation actually asks. Each answer cites a written room.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.summary: Every term collected from the written rooms. Open a term to land in the room that defines it.

pages.title: Ecosystem
pages.summary: One curriculum mind map for all eleven tracks, then a cross-lab concept map. The concept map is orientation only.

pages.title: Ecosystem Atlas
pages.summary: Calling, Contact Center, Meetings, Devices, Control Hub, workforce management, recording, emergency calling, analytics, and AI agents. Diagrams are study drawings. They are not Cisco architecture blueprints.

pages.title: Mastery
pages.summary: Fundamentals through the hard edges. Every row has a place to read. Anything this lab will not pretend to know is marked unverified.

pages.title: Ports and protocols
pages.summary: Taken from the Webex Calling port reference on 2026-10-15. The article's revision history shows the phone source range moving to 5060–5280 on September 07, 2026.

pages.title: Diagrams
pages.summary: 28 custom SVGs. 28 use animateMotion. 23 are tagged as call, signal, or data flows. SMIL runs when the file is embedded as an object.

pages.title: Flows
pages.summary: 23 call, signal, and data flows. Each one is a custom SVG with a moving packet. Architecture diagrams stay on the atlas.

pages.title: Charts
pages.summary: Counts from this repository. No traffic, no revenue, and no invented adoption numbers.

pages.title: Downloads
pages.summary: One-page sheets (26 topics), a 959-card deck harvested from the rooms, and a zip of this site.

pages.title: Play
pages.summary: A port game, a flow map, a call-flow sandbox, a daily question, badges, and a card you can save. Scores stay in this browser.

pages.title: Careers
pages.summary: Study paths through this Canon. Job titles here are study labels, not Cisco requisitions. No salaries.

pages.title: Troubleshooting cases
pages.summary: Each scenario is a decision with a cited consequence. Pick a choice. The note stays on this page. Scores stay in this browser.

pages.title: Countries and residency
pages.summary: Flags mark regions named in the Canon room. This page does not invent carriers, dial plans, or a PSTN country matrix.

pages.title: Certifications
pages.summary: CCNP Collaboration is the core exam plus one concentration. The topic phrases below are the official blurbs retrieved 2026-10-14. This page does not invent domain weights or percentages.
